diagnostic_scope: FIXED 100-SAMPLE CV-BENCH SCREENING. This is a diagnostic cut-point attribution experiment and is explicitly NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. No formal accuracy, promotion, acceleration or hardware claim may be derived from it.
round_scope: CPU-only summariser, preregistration and tests. No GPU run, no board run, no training, no hyper-parameter tuning, no dependency installation. The layer5 L2 screening100 raw JSONL is produced later by the host GPU runner exactly as pinned below; it did not exist when this file was written.
diagnostic_question: With the identical L2 scorer, K=96, region_grid=3 and local_cap=16, does moving the cut point from B1 (after vision block 0) to after vision block 5 change the official CV-Bench screening100 accuracy by more than 0.02?

arms.dense: frozen custom dense (unpruned) path; REFERENCE ONLY, never decision-driving
arms.b1_l2: run_hf_hardware_regular_b1.py --score-mode l2 (min-max normalised group-mean L2 after vision block 0)
arms.layer5_l2: run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_l2.py --score-mode l2 (min-max normalised group-mean L2 after vision block 5; DeepStack index 5 is called on the compact hidden)

primary_metric.definition: Official CV-Bench combined score returned by the frozen scorer evaluation.build_cv_bench_pruning_report.score: ((accuracy_ADE20K + accuracy_COCO)/2 + accuracy_Omni3D)/2.
primary_metric.rule: This is the ONE and ONLY primary metric for every arm (dense, b1_l2, layer5_l2) and for every paired bootstrap comparison. It is never replaced by any other accuracy.

unweighted_metric.definition: Plain unweighted mean over the 100 screening samples.
unweighted_metric.rule: Secondary diagnostic only. It must never be called the CV-Bench primary score and must never drive the decision rule.

dense.subset_rule: restricted to the 100 sample_id values of datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl, preserving manifest order
dense.role: REFERENCE ONLY: unpruned custom-dense reference; it never drives the decision
dense.note: This is the same frozen custom dense JSONL that the formal current-Selector quality report names as dense_jsonl.

b1_l2.role: B1 L2 scorer at the block-0 cut point, K=96, screening100

layer5_l2.role: L2 scorer on the identical K=96 path but at the after-vision-block-5 cut point
layer5_l2.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_l2.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-l2-diagnostic/layer5_l2_k96_screening100.jsonl --score-mode l2 --prune-after-layer 5 --budget 96 --region-grid 3 --local-candidate-cap 16 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

validation_requirements.sample_id_identity: The screening manifest, the dense full2638 subset, the B1 L2 screening100 input and the layer5 L2 screening100 input must all select exactly the same 100 sample_id values.
validation_requirements.no_duplicates: Each of the four inputs must contain no duplicate sample_id.
validation_requirements.score_mode_l2: Every b1 and every layer5 record must have score_mode == "l2".
validation_requirements.budget_k96: Every b1 and every layer5 record must have requested_budget == 96; every non-bypass record must emit exactly K=96 output groups.
validation_requirements.layer5_cutpoint: Every layer5 record must carry prune_after_layer == 5.
validation_requirements.b1_cutpoint: Every b1 record must omit prune_after_layer or set it to 0.
validation_requirements.input_grid_consistency: For every sample_id, the layer5 record's (image_grid_thw, full_patch_tokens, full_llm_visual_tokens) must equal the b1 record's tuple. A mismatch invalidates the comparison and the summariser must fail closed.
validation_requirements.input_sha256: Every non-null inputs_sha256 pin in this file is re-verified before scoring.
validation_requirements.fail_closed: If any required input file is missing, or any of the checks above fails, the summariser must raise and must NOT write a report.

decision_rule.uses: 95% CI of score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] for layer5_minus_b1 only
decision_rule.dense_role: reference only; never drives the decision

ordered_rules.meaning: 切点效应确认：在相同 L2 打分与 K=96 下，layer-5 切点显著优于 B1 切点超过 0.02。
切点效应未确认：证据不足以证明 layer-5 切点相对 B1 切点的提升超过 0.02。

explicit_non_formal_statement: This diagnostic runs on a fixed stratified 100-sample screening set. Its result is a cut-point attribution signal only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion; it must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach, and it does not authorise promotion, RTL work or hardware claims.
limitations: Screening100 is a diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample CV-Bench benchmark.
The Selector path is software only; no FPGA/board result and no latency/acceleration claim is made.
Both Selector arms share the L2 scorer and K=96 but differ only in the cut point; dense uses the frozen custom dense path and is only a reference, not an exactly matched input grid.
Only score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] drives the decision; unweighted_sample_accuracy is descriptive.
The layer5 arm never uses the B1-trained Wv projection.
Validation was already used in development; internal test remains sealed.
